messages.text:
Could you let me name a game before I save it, so its name comes back when I load my saved progress? Please follow the project rules.

Some saved games won't open after I paste them, even though my own exports work. Could you fix that and keep the rest working?

Read docs/README.md and the other documents in docs/ for this project's requirements.

Added a **Deal name** field to the reproduction controls. Names are preserved in version 2 snapshots, restored on import, and cleared when starting or loading a new deal. Unnamed saves remain version 1. See [Reproduction.tsx](/work/src/game/controls/Reproduction.tsx) and [snapshot.ts](/work/src/game/snapshot.ts).

Fixed pasted saves by making snapshot parsing independent of JSON property order while keeping exact-field and progress validation.

**Checks:** typecheck passed; 142 unit tests and all 78 browser journeys passed. Changed files pass formatting checks. The repository-wide format check still flags 13 untouched files.
